Employee Leave Management \(ELM\)

__Workflow Specifications — Final Synchronized v1\.6__

Corrected Basis\-Workflow completeness • 17 complete Basis Workflows • 4 Composite Workflows • authoritative STTs

# 1\. Revision Scope and Authority

Version 1\.6 corrects a Basis\-Workflow derivation defect in v1\.5: reusable substitute\-consent/recovery prefixes were incorrectly counted as Basis Workflows, leaving some complete valid UC sequences \(for example EL\-UC\-001 → EL\-UC\-002 → EL\-UC\-003 for substitute\-required CL/RH\) without a corresponding Basis Workflow\. No PS, CFR/AFR, UC, or BR semantics are changed\.

The Composite Workflows remain semantically unchanged\. Their constituent Basis\-Workflow references are updated to the corrected complete\-path set\. The State\-Transition Table \(STT\) remains authoritative and each diagram is a corresponding visual view\.

# 2\. Workflow Derivation Decisions

1. Derive workflows only from validated state\-changing UCs and applicable BRs\.
2. A Basis Workflow shall be a complete finite valid progression from a meaningful process start/context to a meaningful business outcome; a reusable prefix, suffix, or recovery fragment is not by itself a Basis Workflow unless it independently constitutes such a progression\.
3. A sequence such as Apply → Substitute Response → Unit Head Review must therefore appear as a complete Basis Workflow when it is a valid business path\.
4. When terminal outcomes differ only in the outcome of the same final decision UC and all preceding steps are identical, they may be represented as alternative terminal rows in one Basis Workflow to avoid duplicate path specifications\.
5. A purely configuration\-controlled optional/bypass step \(for example the Establishment routing step\) may remain within the same Basis Workflow when it does not create a different business outcome\.
6. For a meaningful loop, represent zero traversal and exactly one traversal; do not enumerate further equivalent repetitions\.
7. Composite Workflows integrate complete Basis Workflows and may additionally represent cross\-cutting transitions such as pending withdrawal and routing\-changing SLA escalation\.
8. ELM is not its own UC actor\. System may appear in an STT only as the performer of a meaningful automatic transition; time/external events remain triggers/guards\.
9. Pending requests are not modified in place\. Change before final approval is handled through withdrawal and, if needed, a fresh application\.
10. Year\-end processing and reminder/notification\-only SLA handling remain event\-triggered UC\+BR behavior, not standalone workflows\.
11. The STT is authoritative; diagrams must correspond to it exactly\.

# 4\. Basis Workflow Specifications

All Basis Workflows below are complete finite valid paths; no prefix/recovery fragment is counted as a Basis Workflow\.

## BW\-EL\-01 — New CL/RH — No Substitute Gate

__Type__

Basis

__Purpose / Scope__

Process a valid CL/RH application that does not require substitute consent from submission through the Unit Head final decision\.

__Trigger__

Employee submits a valid CL/RH request for which substitute coverage is not required\.

__Participants__

Employee; Unit Head

__Related Workflows__

CW\-EL\-01

__Related CFRs__

CFR\-EL\-002–003, CFR\-EL\-013, CFR\-EL\-016

__Related UCs__

EL\-UC\-001, EL\-UC\-003

__Related BRs__

BR\-EL\-001–013, BR\-EL\-016, BR\-EL\-030–031

## BW\-EL\-02 — New CL/RH — Substitute Accepted \(No Loop\)

__Type__

Basis

__Purpose / Scope__

Process a valid CL/RH application requiring substitute coverage through accepted substitute consent and the Unit Head final decision\.

__Trigger__

Employee submits a valid CL/RH request for which substitute coverage is required\.

__Participants__

Employee; Substitute / Responsibility Holder; Unit Head

__Related Workflows__

CW\-EL\-01

CFR\-EL\-002–003, CFR\-EL\-011–013, CFR\-EL\-016

BR\-EL\-001–016, BR\-EL\-030–031

## BW\-EL\-03 — New CL/RH — Substitute Declined, Replacement Accepted \(One Loop Traversal\)

__Type__

Basis

__Purpose / Scope__

Process a valid CL/RH application through one substitute\-decline recovery traversal, replacement acceptance, and the Unit Head final decision\.

__Trigger__

Employee submits a valid CL/RH request requiring substitute coverage; the first nominee declines\.

__Participants__

Employee; Substitute / Responsibility Holder; Unit Head

__Related Workflows__

CW\-EL\-01

__Related CFRs__

CFR\-EL\-002–003, CFR\-EL\-011–013, CFR\-EL\-016

__Related UCs__

EL\-UC\-001, EL\-UC\-002, EL\-UC\-019, EL\-UC\-003

__Related BRs__

BR\-EL\-001–016, BR\-EL\-030–031

## BW\-EL\-04 — New Higher\-Sanction Leave — No Substitute Gate

__Type__

Basis

__Purpose / Scope__

Process a valid SCL/EL/COL/VL application not requiring substitute consent from submission through Unit Head recommendation and final sanction\.

__Trigger__

Employee submits a valid higher\-sanction leave request for which substitute coverage is not required\.

__Participants__

Employee; Unit Head; Establishment where configured; final Sanctioning Authority

__Related Workflows__

## BW\-EL\-05 — New Higher\-Sanction Leave — Substitute Accepted \(No Loop\)

__Type__

Basis

__Purpose / Scope__

Process a valid SCL/EL/COL/VL application requiring substitute coverage through accepted consent, Unit Head recommendation, and final sanction\.

__Trigger__

Employee submits a valid higher\-sanction leave request for which substitute coverage is required\.

__Participants__

Employee; Substitute / Responsibility Holder; Unit Head; Establishment where configured; final Sanctioning Authority

__Related Workflows__

CW\-EL\-01

__Related CFRs__

CFR\-EL\-002–003, CFR\-EL\-011–012, CFR\-EL\-014, CFR\-EL\-016

__Related UCs__

EL\-UC\-001, EL\-UC\-002, EL\-UC\-003, EL\-UC\-004, EL\-UC\-005

__Related BRs__

BR\-EL\-001–019, BR\-EL\-030–031

## BW\-EL\-06 — New Higher\-Sanction Leave — Substitute Declined, Replacement Accepted \(One Loop Traversal\)

__Type__

Basis

__Purpose / Scope__

Process a valid SCL/EL/COL/VL application through one substitute\-decline recovery traversal, Unit Head recommendation, and final sanction\.

__Trigger__

Employee submits a valid higher\-sanction leave request requiring substitute coverage; the first nominee declines\.

__Participants__

Employee; Substitute / Responsibility Holder; Unit Head; Establishment where configured; final Sanctioning Authority

__Related Workflows__

CW\-EL\-01

__Related CFRs__

CFR\-EL\-002–003, CFR\-EL\-011–012, CFR\-EL\-014, CFR\-EL\-016

__Related UCs__

EL\-UC\-001, EL\-UC\-002, EL\-UC\-019, EL\-UC\-003, EL\-UC\-004, EL\-UC\-005

__Related BRs__

BR\-EL\-001–019, BR\-EL\-030–031

## BW\-EL\-07 — Director Self\-Sanction — No Substitute Gate

__Type__

Basis

__Purpose / Scope__

Process a valid Director\-applicant new leave request not requiring substitute consent from submission through the Director self\-sanction decision\.

__Trigger__

Director, acting as employee applicant, submits a valid request for which substitute coverage is not required\.

__Participants__

Director as Employee; Director as Sanctioning Authority

__Related Workflows__

CW\-EL\-01

__Related CFRs__

CFR\-EL\-002–003, CFR\-EL\-015–016

__Related UCs__

EL\-UC\-001, EL\-UC\-005

__Related BRs__

BR\-EL\-001–013, BR\-EL\-020, BR\-EL\-030–031

## BW\-EL\-08 — Director Self\-Sanction — Substitute Accepted \(No Loop\)

__Type__

Basis

__Purpose / Scope__

Process a valid Director\-applicant new leave request requiring substitute coverage through accepted consent and the Director self\-sanction decision\.

__Trigger__

Director, acting as employee applicant, submits a valid request requiring substitute coverage\.

__Participants__

Director as Employee; Substitute / Responsibility Holder; Director as Sanctioning Authority

__Related Workflows__

CW\-EL\-01

__Related CFRs__

CFR\-EL\-002–003, CFR\-EL\-011–012, CFR\-EL\-015–016

__Related UCs__

EL\-UC\-001, EL\-UC\-002, EL\-UC\-005

__Related BRs__

BR\-EL\-001–015, BR\-EL\-020, BR\-EL\-030–031

### Authoritative State\-Transition Table

__S\. No\.__

__From State__

__Actor__

__Use Case ID / Name__

__Guard / Outcome__

__Resulting State__

__BR Reference\(s\)__

1

Employee

Submission valid; substitute required

BR\-EL\-001–015, BR\-EL\-030–031

2

Awaiting Substitute Response

Substitute / Responsibility Holder

EL\-UC\-002 / Respond to Substitute Request

Outcome = Accept; applicant is Director

Awaiting Director Self\-Sanction

BR\-EL\-014–015, BR\-EL\-020

Approved

BR\-EL\-020

4

Awaiting Director Self\-Sanction

Director \(Sanctioning Authority role\)

Outcome = Reject

Rejected

BR\-EL\-020

## BW\-EL\-09 — Director Self\-Sanction — Substitute Declined, Replacement Accepted \(One Loop Traversal\)

__Type__

Basis

__Purpose / Scope__

Process a valid Director\-applicant new leave request through one substitute\-decline recovery traversal and the Director self\-sanction decision\.

__Trigger__

Director, acting as employee applicant, submits a valid request requiring substitute coverage; the first nominee declines\.

__Participants__

Director as Employee; Substitute / Responsibility Holder; Director as Sanctioning Authority

__Related Workflows__

CW\-EL\-01

__Related CFRs__

CFR\-EL\-002–003, CFR\-EL\-011–012, CFR\-EL\-015–016

__Related UCs__

EL\-UC\-001, EL\-UC\-002, EL\-UC\-019, EL\-UC\-005

__Related BRs__

BR\-EL\-001–015, BR\-EL\-020, BR\-EL\-030–031

## BW\-EL\-10 — CL/RH Approved\-Leave Cancellation

__Type__

Basis

__Purpose / Scope__

Process cancellation of an approved CL/RH before its start from employee request through the Unit Head final cancellation decision\.

__Trigger__

Employee requests cancellation of approved CL/RH before its start\.

__Participants__

Employee; Unit Head

__Related Workflows__

CW\-EL\-02

__Related CFRs__

CFR\-EL\-019

__Related UCs__

EL\-UC\-008, EL\-UC\-003

__Related BRs__

BR\-EL\-016, BR\-EL\-023–024

## BW\-EL\-11 — Higher\-Sanction Approved\-Leave Cancellation

__Type__

Basis

__Purpose / Scope__

Process cancellation of an approved higher\-sanction leave before its start through the applicable recommendation/routing hierarchy and final cancellation decision\.

__Trigger__

Employee requests cancellation of approved SCL/EL/COL/VL before its start\.

__Participants__

Employee; Unit Head; Establishment where configured; final Sanctioning Authority

__Related Workflows__

CW\-EL\-02

__Related CFRs__

CFR\-EL\-019

__Related UCs__

EL\-UC\-008, EL\-UC\-003, EL\-UC\-004, EL\-UC\-005

__Related BRs__

BR\-EL\-017–019, BR\-EL\-023–024, BR\-EL\-030

## BW\-EL\-12 — Ongoing Leave Extension — No Substitute Gate

__Type__

Basis

__Purpose / Scope__

Process an admissible EL/COL/VL extension not requiring substitute consent from submission through Unit Head recommendation and final sanction\.

__Trigger__

Employee on ongoing EL/COL/VL requests additional leave time; substitute coverage is not required\.

__Participants__

Employee; Unit Head; Establishment where configured; final Sanctioning Authority

__Related Workflows__

CW\-EL\-03

__Related CFRs__

CFR\-EL\-020

__Related UCs__

EL\-UC\-009, EL\-UC\-003, EL\-UC\-004, EL\-UC\-005

__Related BRs__

BR\-EL\-001, BR\-EL\-005–013, BR\-EL\-017–019, BR\-EL\-025, BR\-EL\-030–031

## BW\-EL\-13 — Ongoing Leave Extension — Substitute Accepted \(No Loop\)

__Type__

Basis

__Purpose / Scope__

Process an admissible EL/COL/VL extension requiring substitute coverage through accepted consent, Unit Head recommendation, and final sanction\.

__Trigger__

Employee on ongoing EL/COL/VL requests additional leave time; substitute coverage is required\.

__Participants__

Employee; Substitute / Responsibility Holder; Unit Head; Establishment where configured; final Sanctioning Authority

__Related Workflows__

CW\-EL\-03

__Related CFRs__

CFR\-EL\-011–012, CFR\-EL\-020

__Related UCs__

EL\-UC\-009, EL\-UC\-002, EL\-UC\-003, EL\-UC\-004, EL\-UC\-005

__Related BRs__

BR\-EL\-001, BR\-EL\-005–019, BR\-EL\-025, BR\-EL\-030–031

## BW\-EL\-14 — Ongoing Leave Extension — Substitute Declined, Replacement Accepted \(One Loop Traversal\)

__Type__

Basis

__Purpose / Scope__

Process an admissible EL/COL/VL extension through one substitute\-decline recovery traversal, Unit Head recommendation, and final sanction\.

__Trigger__

Employee on ongoing EL/COL/VL requests additional leave time requiring substitute coverage; the first nominee declines\.

__Participants__

Employee; Substitute / Responsibility Holder; Unit Head; Establishment where configured; final Sanctioning Authority

__Related Workflows__

CW\-EL\-03

__Related CFRs__

CFR\-EL\-011–012, CFR\-EL\-020

__Related UCs__

EL\-UC\-009, EL\-UC\-002, EL\-UC\-019, EL\-UC\-003, EL\-UC\-004, EL\-UC\-005

__Related BRs__

BR\-EL\-001, BR\-EL\-005–019, BR\-EL\-025, BR\-EL\-030–031

## BW\-EL\-15 — Normal Resumption Review

__Type__

Basis

__Purpose / Scope__

Record employee resumption and review a normal return from EL/COL/VL without changing the approved period or balance\.

__Trigger__

Employee returns on the approved end date and submits actual resumption information\.

__Participants__

Employee; applicable Sanctioning Authority

## BW\-EL\-16 — Early Resumption Review

__Type__

Basis

__Purpose / Scope__

Record employee resumption and review an early return from EL/COL/VL, then synchronize the actual period, balance, leave record, and attendance\.

__Trigger__

Employee returns before the approved end date and submits actual resumption information\.

__Participants__

Employee; applicable Sanctioning Authority

__Related Workflows__

CW\-EL\-04

__Related CFRs__

CFR\-EL\-021

__Related UCs__

EL\-UC\-010, EL\-UC\-011

__Related BRs__

BR\-EL\-027–028

## BW\-EL\-17 — Late Resumption Review

__Type__

Basis

__Purpose / Scope__

Record employee resumption and review a late return from EL/COL/VL, then synchronize the actual period, balance, leave record, and attendance\.

__Trigger__

Employee returns after the approved end date and submits actual resumption information\.

__Participants__

Employee; applicable Sanctioning Authority

__Related Workflows__

CW\-EL\-04

__Related CFRs__

CFR\-EL\-021

__Related UCs__

EL\-UC\-010, EL\-UC\-011

# 5\. Composite Workflow Specifications

## CW\-EL\-01 — New Leave Processing and Pending Withdrawal

__Type__

Composite

__Purpose / Scope__

Provide the end\-to\-end progression for a new leave request, including substitute consent/recovery, Unit\-Head\-final CL/RH decisions, higher\-sanction routing, the Director\-specific self\-sanction route, and immediate withdrawal from every valid pending pre\-final state\.

__Trigger__

Employee submits a valid new leave request\.

__Participants__

Employee; Substitute / Responsibility Holder where required; Unit Head; Establishment where configured; final Sanctioning Authority; Director in self\-sanction case

__Constituent Workflows__

BW\-EL\-01–09

__Related Workflows__

CW\-EL\-02; CW\-EL\-03; CW\-EL\-04

__Related CFRs__

CFR\-EL\-002–003, CFR\-EL\-011–018

__Related UCs__

EL\-UC\-001–005, EL\-UC\-007, EL\-UC\-019

__Related BRs__

BR\-EL\-001–020, BR\-EL\-022, BR\-EL\-030–035

__*Specification Notes*__

- Pending in\-place modification is not supported\. Change before final approval is handled by withdrawal and, if needed, a fresh application\.
- Pending withdrawal is cross\-cutting across every valid pending pre\-final state\.
- Conditional routing/responsibility\-changing SLA escalation uses XTP\-EL\-01 where applicable\.

## CW\-EL\-02 — Approved Leave Cancellation

__Type__

Composite

__Purpose / Scope__

Represent cancellation of approved leave before its start through the same applicable decision hierarchy, with distinct cancellation\-approved and cancellation\-rejected effects\. A later revised leave request is a fresh New Leave instance, not part of this workflow\.

__Trigger__

Employee requests cancellation of an approved leave before its start date\.

__Participants__

Employee; Unit Head; Establishment where configured; final Sanctioning Authority

__Constituent Workflows__

BW\-EL\-10–11

__Related Workflows__

CW\-EL\-01; CW\-EL\-03; CW\-EL\-04

__Related CFRs__

CFR\-EL\-019

__Related UCs__

EL\-UC\-008, EL\-UC\-003–005

__Related BRs__

BR\-EL\-016–019, BR\-EL\-023–024, BR\-EL\-030

## CW\-EL\-03 — Ongoing Leave Extension

__Type__

Composite

__Purpose / Scope__

Represent an extension of ongoing EL/COL/VL through applicable validation, substitute consent/recovery where required, Unit Head recommendation, configured higher\-sanction decision, and immediate withdrawal of the pending extension request where applicable\.

__Trigger__

Employee on ongoing EL/COL/VL requests additional leave time\.

__Participants__

Employee; Substitute / Responsibility Holder where required; Unit Head; Establishment where configured; final Sanctioning Authority

__Constituent Workflows__

BW\-EL\-12–14

__Related Workflows__

CW\-EL\-01; CW\-EL\-02; CW\-EL\-04

__Related CFRs__

CFR\-EL\-020, CFR\-EL\-018 where pending\-extension withdrawal applies

__Related UCs__

EL\-UC\-009, EL\-UC\-002–005, EL\-UC\-007, EL\-UC\-019

__Related BRs__

BR\-EL\-001, BR\-EL\-005–019, BR\-EL\-022, BR\-EL\-025, BR\-EL\-030–031

__*Specification Notes*__

- Extension approval posts only the incremental additional period; rejection preserves the original approved leave\.
- Pending extension withdrawal is cross\-cutting across all valid pending extension states\.

## CW\-EL\-04 — Resumption Review

__Type__

Composite

__Purpose / Scope__

Coordinate employee submission of actual resumption information with review by the applicable Sanctioning Authority, distinguishing normal, early, and late return without inventing a generic leave\-closure state\.

__Trigger__

Employee returns from EL/COL/VL and submits actual resumption information\.

__Participants__

Employee; applicable Sanctioning Authority

__Constituent Workflows__

BW\-EL\-15–17

__Related Workflows__

CW\-EL\-02; CW\-EL\-03

__Related CFRs__

CFR\-EL\-021

__Related UCs__

EL\-UC\-010, EL\-UC\-011

__Related BRs__

BR\-EL\-027–028

__*Specification Notes*__

- No generic Closed leave state is introduced\.

# 6\. Cross\-Cutting Automatic SLA Routing / Responsibility Escalation Pattern

__Pattern ID__

XTP\-EL\-01

__Applies To__

Any SLA\-controlled actionable task state in CW\-EL\-01–04 where the configured escalation changes routing/responsibility\.

__Trigger__

Configured escalation threshold reached\.

__Performer__

System \(workflow transition performer; not a UC actor\)\.

__Related UC__

EL\-UC\-021 / Process SLA Threshold Event

__Related BRs__

BR\-EL\-033, BR\-EL\-038
